doc: Precision nutrition-based interventions for the management of obesity in children and adolescents up to the age of 19 years

entries.claim: 对于0-9岁肥胖儿童，精准营养干预与常规建议相比，可能对腰围几乎没有影响。
entries.source_doc: Precision nutrition-based interventions for the management of obesity in children and adolescents up to the age of 19 years

entries.claim: 对于6-18岁儿童青少年，基于基因型的精准营养干预（低乳糖饮食）与乳糖酶补充相比，对胰岛素抵抗指数有负面效应，但可能无临床意义。
